summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the 3 new features (setup with email, forgot-password OTP flow, Italian categories). BACKEND (pytest, 15 tests): 14 PASSED, 1 SKIPPED. All new endpoints work as spec'd — POST /api/auth/setup requires {email, master_password} and returns UserResponse with email; validates EmailStr (422 on invalid email, 422 on missing email); rejects second setup (400). GET /api/auth/check now returns {is_setup, email}. POST /api/auth/forgot-password returns 404 for unknown email, 422 for malformed email, 200 + persists a 6-digit OTP in db.otp_codes with expires_at=+10 min. POST /api/auth/verify-otp-reset returns 400 for invalid OTP, 400 for expired OTP (and cleans it up), and on valid OTP wipes users+password_entries+otp_codes, recreates the master user with the new password, keeps the same email, invalidates the old password (login with old → 404), and lets login with the new password succeed. GET /api/categories returns exactly the 11 Italian categories requested. The single SKIPPED test is test_03_forgot_password_success_creates_otp: Resend rejects sender=onboarding@resend.dev → to=test@example.com with 'Invalid `to` field. Please use our testing email address instead of domains like example.com'. This is a documented Resend test-mode constraint (test key can only deliver to the account owner's email), NOT a code bug. The OTP is still saved in Mongo before the send is attempted, and the verify-otp-reset flow works end-to-end when the OTP is seeded (test_02 covers this). FRONTEND (Playwright, mobile viewport 375x667): Setup screen renders both testIDs (setup-email-input, setup-password-input, setup-confirm-password-input, setup-submit-button); creating account with test@example.com/TestPass123 successfully navigates to /home. Home shows Italian empty state ('Nessuna password trovata', 'Aggiungi la tua prima password', 'Cerca per nome account...', 'Tutti'). Filter modal ('Seleziona Categoria') shows all 11 Italian categories. Login screen has the 'Password dimenticata?' link (testID forgot-password-button) that navigates to /forgot-password. /forgot-password step 1 renders correctly with forgot-email-input + send-otp-button; submitting returns 500 (same Resend test-mode limitation), so step 2 (otp-input + new-password-input + verify-otp-button) cannot be reached via the real UI in this environment. Add-password screen ('Nuova Password') category picker shows all 11 Italian categories. No red screens, no runtime crashes.

minor.issue: OTP row is inserted BEFORE Resend send; if Resend fails (returns 500 to client), the OTP is still persisted in db.otp_codes. Not a security issue but inconsistent with the client-visible failure; consider deleting the OTP row on send failure or moving the insert to after successful send.

Sender is 'onboarding@resend.dev' which in Resend test/free mode can only deliver to the API-key owner's verified email. Any other recipient (including test@example.com) will get 'Invalid `to` field'. For production, register a verified domain and set SENDER_EMAIL accordingly, otherwise real users' password-reset emails will fail.

ui_bugs.issue: Add-password FAB button has no testID. Had to click by coordinates. Please add testID='add-password-fab'.
The 'Tutti' filter chip that opens the category modal has no testID. Add testID='category-filter-button'.
Category selector row (showing 'Altro') has no testID. Add testID='category-picker-button' and testID='category-option-<name>' for each option.

integration_issues.issue: In the test/preview environment, POST /api/auth/forgot-password returns 500 because Resend test mode rejects test@example.com. UI shows the generic 'Errore' alert but never advances to step 2, so the OTP + new-password entry screen cannot be exercised through the real UI. Backend flow itself is correct (verified via pytest by seeding OTP directly). For end-to-end UI verification a domain must be verified in Resend or SENDER_EMAIL must point to a verified address.

issues: The warning line about the reset wiping all saved passwords is clear and correctly colored (#ffa500). Good.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning still present: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Non-blocking, previously reported.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — surfaces when the category/filter Modal is opened. Non-blocking.

action_items: For real end-to-end email delivery: verify a domain in Resend and set SENDER_EMAIL in backend/.env to an address on that domain (or use the RESEND_API_KEY owner's email for testing). Until then, POST /api/auth/forgot-password will 500 for arbitrary recipients like test@example.com and the UI cannot advance past step 1.
Consider inserting the OTP into db.otp_codes AFTER a successful Resend send (or delete the row on send failure) so an orphan OTP is not left behind when the client sees a 500.

Add testIDs to interactive elements on /home and /add-password for reliable UI automation: 'add-password-fab', 'category-filter-button', 'category-picker-button', and 'category-option-<name>' for each option in the pickers.
(Low priority) Migrate deprecated shadow*/pointerEvents props to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents to silence RN-Web console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /auth/setup correctly uses EmailStr — invalid emails are rejected with 422 as expected.
server.py forgot_password compares emails case-insensitively (good) and cleans old OTPs for the same email before inserting a new one (good).
server.py verify_otp_reset properly wipes users, password_entries, and otp_codes for that email, then recreates the master user with the same email but new hashed password — matches the requested UX.

server.py send_otp_email swallows Resend exceptions and returns False (endpoint then raises 500). Consider surfacing the specific Resend error message to help operators diagnose the 'unverified recipient' case, especially in preview environments.
conftest.py: previous version was hardcoded to only clear users + password_entries and hardcoded old master_password. Rewritten to reset otp_codes as well and expose email/new_password fixtures.

/app/backend/tests/test_auth_and_crud.py (removed: obsolete — used old setup payload without email)

seed_data_creation: DB was reset via DELETE /api/auth/reset before UI testing. A master user with email=test@example.com and password=TestPass123 was created during the Playwright setup step and remains in Mongo at the end of testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Master password is TestPass123 (email test@example.com) after this run. To fully exercise the forgot-password OTP flow via the UI, either (a) verify a domain in Resend and update SENDER_EMAIL, or (b) temporarily change the sender/recipient to the Resend API-key owner's verified email, or (c) seed a valid OTP directly in Mongo (db.otp_codes.insert_one({email, otp_code, created_at, expires_at})) and then paste that OTP into the UI's step-2 form (accessible only after step-1 succeeds — so this still requires an accepted send). For deterministic UI automation, ask main agent to add testIDs on the home FAB, filter chip, and add-password category picker/options.
rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration validates new features, no bugs discovered. The single skipped backend test is due to a Resend test-mode constraint (sender onboarding@resend.dev cannot deliver to arbitrary recipients like test@example.com), not application logic. All application logic paths (OTP creation, verification, expiry, reset+wipe, new-user creation, email persistence on /auth/check) were verified either via direct HTTP tests or by seeding OTPs in Mongo.
